headline: Dual language school model, reuse of 617 Lexington Street, and a 617 transformer project are on the agenda.
summary: Closed-door talks will cover contract bargaining with five employee groups and an arbitration case over a senior custodian at Whittemore Elementary School. Open discussion will cover school improvement plans, the high school schedule, and bills on the warrant.

plain_text:
WALTHAM SCHOOL COMMITTEE 
 Waltham, Massachusetts 
 JAMES J. CANNON LECTURE HALL  617 LEXINGTON STREET 
 DOCKET  NOVEMBER 18, 2026 
 *ADDENDUM* 
 5:30 p.m.  EXECUTIVE SESSION 
 1.  To conduct strategy sessions with respect to collective bargaining with the WSSA and/or to 
 conduct negotiations with the WSSA 
 2.  To conduct strategy sessions with respect to collective bargaining with the WSAA and/or to 
 conduct negotiations with the WSAA 
 3.  To conduct strategy sessions with respect to collective bargaining with the Waltham School MIS 
 Technicians and/or to conduct negotiations with the Waltham School MIS Technicians 
 4.  To conduct strategy sessions with respect to collective bargaining with the Waltham School 
 Department Food Service Workers and/or to conduct negotiations with the Waltham School 
 Department Food Service Workers 
 5.  To conduct strategy sessions with respect to collective bargaining with the Waltham Building 
 Maintenance Workers Association and/or to conduct negotiations with the Waltham Building 
 Maintenance Workers Association 
 6.  To discuss strategy with respect to litigation under Purpose 3 if an open meeting may have a 
 detrimental effect on the litigating position of the public body and the chair so declares – Waltham 
 Building Maintenance Workers Association and Waltham School Committee, Formal Demand for 
 Arbitration Dated November 7, 2026, Senior Custodian Whittemore Elementary School - 
 *ADDENDUM* 
 7:00 p.m.  REGULAR  MEETING 
 1.  PUBLIC INPUT 
 2.  STUDENT COUNCIL / STUDENT INPUT 
 3.  SCHOOL COUNCIL / PTO / SEPAC / BELPAC INPUT 
 4.  CONSENT AGENDA 
 a)  Minutes from the Regular Meeting held on November 4, 2026 
 b)  Retirements 
 c)  Resignations 
 5.  COMMUNICATIONS 
 6.  SUPERINTENDENT’S UPDATE 
 a)  Miscellaneous Personnel 
 b)  Information 
 7.  CURRICULUM AND INSTRUCTION 
 a)  School Improvement Plan - Plympton Elementary School 
 b)  School Improvement Plan - FitzGerald Elementary School 
 8.  UNFINISHED BUSINESS 
 a)  Anti-Racism, Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 
 b)  Dual Language School Model and the Reutilization of 617 Lexington Street 
 c)  Waltham High School’s Career and Technical Education  (CTE) Department 
 d)  Waltham High School Schedule 
 e)  Enrollment, Space and Data in the Waltham Public Schools 
 f)  School Committee Subcommittee Meetings 
 9.  NEW BUSINESS 
 a)  2027-2028 Waltham Public Schools District Calendar survey 
 b)  Year-to-date Waltham Public Schools Disciplinary Data 
 c)  Interim Assistant Superintendent for Finance and Operations 
 10.  FISCAL MATTERS 
 a)  617 Transformer Project 
 b)  Bills on Warrant 
 11.  AGENDA ITEMS FOR FUTURE MEETINGS 
 The listings of matters are those reasonably anticipated by the Chair which may be discussed at the meeting. Not all items listed may in fact be 
 discussed and other items not listed may also be brought up for discussion to the extent permitted by law.
